entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Granddaughter of the Keldon warlord Astor and an elf of Skyshroud, a potential planeswalker whose spark was extinguished by closing time rifts, who becomes leader of Keld.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: A Keldon warlord, Radha's grandfather, famous for his daggers.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who first discovered Radha as a new breed of potential planeswalker and whom she aided against the time rifts.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A barbarian planeswalker with latent Phage powers who used Radha to close the time rifts.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker whose xenophobic stance toward her elven people Radha disputed.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The being of Yavimaya who bonded Radha to Yavimaya so she could use green mana again.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who took Jeska on Madara and sent his shadow assassin against the mortals.

entities.name: Dinne il-Vec
entities.description: Leshrac's shadow assassin, killed by Radha on Madara.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A companion of Radha who helped close the rifts.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A companion of Radha on Madara.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The planeswalker who closed the Madaran rift after Leshrac was defeated.

entities.name: Skive
entities.description: One of Radha's lieutenants in Keld.

entities.name: Dassene
entities.description: One of Radha's lieutenants in Keld.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose timely arrival let Radha escape the Cabal's Stronghold.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Gideon, sought the Blackblade with Radha's help.

entities.name: Whisper
entities.description: A figure killed by Radha during her escape from the Cabal.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who revealed the New Phyrexian invasion at the Oyster Bay summit.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A faction that captured Radha and forced her to fight in the Stronghold's pit.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: The homeland of the Keldons, which Radha leads.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: The warrior people of Keld, led by Radha.

entities.name: Gathans
entities.description: A rival people whom Radha drove from Keld; she defeated their last warlord.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: The forest home of Radha's elves, whose destruction left a vacancy in her soul.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest where Jeska used Radha to close a time rift.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Where Jeska first used Radha to channel mana into a rift.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Where Jeska was taken by Leshrac and Radha fought his shadow assassin.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Site of the last time rift, closed by Jeska.

entities.name: Oyster Bay
entities.description: Site of the peace summit between Keld and Benalia.

entities.name: The Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: The crisis of time rifts over Dominaria in which Radha played a role.

entities.name: The New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria in which Radha fought.

events.summary: Radha aids Teferi against the time rifts and drives the Gathans from Keld.
events.quote: She aided the planeswalker Teferi during his attempts to save Dominaria from the time rifts

events.summary: Jeska asks Radha for help, Radha refuses, and Jeska wins their fight using her latent Phage powers.
events.quote: Radha refused, and the two barbarian women fought.

events.summary: Jeska takes the tethered Radha to Zhalfir and uses her to channel mana and close the rift, greatly weakening her.
events.quote: Radha was greatly weakened by this act.

events.summary: Multani bonds Radha to Yavimaya, restoring her green mana, and Jeska uses her to close the Yavimaya rift.
events.quote: Jeska then used Radha again to close the rift in Yavimaya.

events.summary: Radha kills Leshrac's shadow assassin Dinne il-Vec on Madara.
Radha and Venser accompany Jeska to the Otarian rift, where Jeska's final act closes all rifts.
events.quote: Jeska's final act closed the Otarian rift, as well as all others.

events.summary: Radha claims her Keldon heritage on the Mountain, retrieves Astor's daggers and leads the new nation of Keld; her planeswalker spark is permanently extinguished.
events.quote: thus she will never be able to ascend.

events.summary: Radha defeats the last Gathan warlord and becomes Grand Warlord of Keld.
events.quote: Radha defeated the last Gathan warlord and became the Grand Warlord of Keld.

events.summary: Radha is captured by the Cabal and forced to fight in the Stronghold's pit; Gideon Jura's arrival lets her escape, and she kills Whisper.
events.quote: During the escape, she ended up killing Whisper .

events.summary: Radha helps Gideon and Chandra find the Blackblade and organizes the spirits of Urborg against the Cabal.
events.quote: and organized the spirits of Urborg in their attack on the Cabal .

events.summary: Radha leads the Keldon delegation at the Oyster Bay peace summit, interrupted when Karn and Teferi reveal the Phyrexian threat and Phyrexian sleeper agents among the Benalish knights.
events.quote: Radha led the Keldon delegation at the peace summit at Oyster Bay

events.summary: Radha fights in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Radha fought in defense of Dominaria during the
